name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand just behind the bell with your feet outside hip width and hinge at the hips to grasp the handle with both hands.
Hike the kettlebell firmly back between your upper thighs while packing your lats down.
Snap your hips powerfully forward and squeeze your glutes and abs to project the kettlebell forward up to roughly chest height with straight arms.
Let the bell fall and hinge as it reaches your thighs.
To finish, guide the bell forward onto the floor after the backswing.
tips: Perform a crisp hip hinge rather than a squat, keeping your shins nearly vertical.
Avoid leaning backward at the top of the swing; stand tall in a rigid vertical plank.
